instruction: A candid wide shot photograph captures an indoor motion capture studio featuring a dark red carpet and white walls. On the left side of the frame, the man in the black cap and blue shorts (R1) stands facing right, receiving a blow. On the right, the woman in the white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) balances on her left leg, delivering a high side kick with her right foot directly to the man's thigh. The scene is illuminated by bright, neutral overhead lights, creating a clear and evenly lit environment.
